#   Peak_TFLOPS: number [TFLOP/s] — Peak dense FP16 or BF16 Tensor Core throughput without sparsity
#   Memory_Bandwidth_GBps: number [GB/s] — Peak HBM package memory bandwidth
#   Memory_Capacity_GiB: number [GiB] — HBM capacity per accelerator package (vendor-labeled GB)

#   Source: string [URL] — Primary NVIDIA datasheet or product specification URL

# Notes: Per-row vendor datasheet URLs are recorded in the Source column; Peak_TFLOPS is dense FP16/BF16 Tensor Core rate without sparsity. V100 SXM2 launched in 2017 (16 GB) with the 32 GB HBM2 SKU released in March 2018; capacity figures follow vendor GB datasheet labels.
